answer: Identity behavior carries grain: cedar cuts coarse, walnut cuts fine, and no two honest accounts pattern alike. A nightly sweep replays each account's public history — timing, cadence, relay choices — and fuses matching grain into one cluster, since a cloned farm only stamps hollow copies of one prototype. Fusion triggers joint clawback: the cluster's bonds and past rewards are revoked together. Every fake must sustain a distinct persona 24/7 — its own schedule, phrasing and relays — a full operator's wage per identity, or one matched pair burns the fleet.
